name: Mr. B the Bitcoin Trader
teaser: Adds Mr. B the shady bitcoin merchant.
description_html:
Adds Mr. B who deals with bitcoin. This mod was centered around bitcoin being ₽357000. He will offer cases, high end items, keycards, and eventually more items to buy with bitcoin and he will also trade you bitcoin for certain items too. If you think anything should be added let me know and I am still working out the prices so expect some changes in the next few days or weeks.

To install just unpack and place in your user mods folder.
